meta.prompt: Run a quick team poll in a card: "Where should we go for lunch on Friday?" with four options and their votes so far: Pho Saigon 5, Taqueria Luz 8, Green Bowl 3, Napoli Pizza 6. Before I vote I only see the options. When I vote, my vote is counted and I see each option's share as a bar with the percentage (rounded to a whole number), my choice marked as mine, and the total number of votes.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Team lunch poll" "Friday, where should we go?" icon:"how_to_vote" status:"Open"
  state pick=""
  state votes={"Pho Saigon":5,"Taqueria Luz":8,"Green Bowl":3,"Napoli Pizza":6}
  let total = sum(map(["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"], n => votes[n]))
  if pick==""
    Paragraph "Where should we go for lunch on Friday? Pick one option and vote."
    OptionList "Where should we go for lunch on Friday?" =pick options:["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"]
    ActionButton "Vote" primary enabled:{pick!=""} -> votes=with(votes,pick,votes[pick]+1)
  if pick!=""
    Paragraph "Thanks, your vote for {pick} is counted."
    each n in ["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"]
      Row between
        Text.strong "{n}{n==pick ? ' (your vote)' : ''}"
        Text.muted "{round(votes[n]*100/total,0)}%"
      Progress {votes[n]/total}
    TotalBar "Total votes" "{total} votes so far" amount:{total} cta "Done" enabled:{false}

delta: Where should we go for lunch
